title: Michelle L. Jacko, Esq., Selected to the 2025 San Diego Super Lawyers List | User | dailytimesleader.com
text:
SAN DIEGO - March 19, 2025 - PRLog -- Michelle L. Jacko, Esq. has been selected to the 2025 San Diego Super Lawyers list. Each year, no more than five percent of lawyers in the state are selected by the research team at Super Lawyers to receive this honor.
Ms. Jacko is the founder of Jacko Law Group, PC a San Diego-based Corporate and Securities law firm. Jacko Law Group provides securities, corporate, M&A, litigation, and regulatory compliance counsel to investment advisers, broker-dealers, private funds, investment companies, financial advisors and others in the financial services industry and corporate sector.
Ms. Jacko's practice focuses on securities law regulatory counsel, with emphasis on investment adviser and broker-dealer considerations, FINRA and SEC examinations, investigations, and enforcement matters, compliance program development, risk mitigation, and investment counsel. She also counsels clients on corporate transactions including mergers and acquisitions, exit planning and more.
She is a frequent presenter at national compliance conferences and a regular contributor to leading industry publications. She is a two-term board member of the National Society of Compliance Professionals and co-founder of the Southern California Compliance Group. Ms. Jacko is a FINRA arbitrator and holds NSCP's Certified Securities Compliance Professional (CSCP) designation. In addition, she is a member of the National Association of Women Lawyers (NAWL). Ms. Jacko has been included in the San Diego Super Lawyers guide since 2023.
For years, San Diego Super Lawyers has recognized outstanding legal professionals who demonstrate exceptional legal expertise and ethical standards. Attorneys are nominated by their peers and undergo an extensive evaluation and selection process, making Super Lawyers one of the most trusted and respected attorney-ranking platforms in the region.
About Jacko Law Group, PC
Jacko Law Group, PC is a woman-owned, nationally recognized corporate and securities law firm specializing in securities regulatory counsel and compliance services, mergers and acquisitions, private funds, registration, strategic business planning, and litigation services for companies and individuals within the financial industry. For more information, please visit www.jackolg.com .
